normalized.result: I'd want the **keep-the-address version**. The reason I save something is so I don't lose the link — so if the app can reach a valid address but just can't fetch the title or make its copy this time, the worst thing it could do is refuse and leave me with nothing. I'd rather it hang onto the bookmark, mark it clearly as needing another try, and let me come back and retry gathering the details later (or just fill in the title myself). Losing the link entirely because the extras didn't load would defeat the whole point. So: save it, flag it, offer the retry — that's the one to use.
